title: Hurun India 500: NSE retains India’s most valuable unlisted company tag, ahead of Serum Institute, Adani Properties
summary: The National Stock Exchange (NSE) leads India's most valuable unlisted companies with a Rs 4.86 lakh crore valuation, according to the 2025 Burgundy Private Hurun India 500 report. This comes as NSE files for a massive IPO.
